workflow.name: Weekly sales brief
workflow.description: SQL demo: last week's sales by region and product category, summarised and sent to Telegram.

config.query: SELECT r.name AS region, p.category, sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price)::numeric(12, 2) AS sales, count(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id WHERE o.ordered_at > (SELECT max(ordered_at) FROM orders) - $1::int GROUP BY r.name, p.category ORDER BY sales DESC

steps.name: Write the brief
steps.prompt_template:
The rows below are last week's sales of a wholesaler, by region and product category (sales in euros, number of orders), as JSON. Write a short sales brief for the team: the week's total, the strongest and the weakest region, and the categories worth a mention. Use only these numbers. At most 150 words.

{input}
